description: Erection of detached single storey outbuilding to the rear of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (TP/405/01; TP/405/02 and TP/405/03  Received:  12 August  2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional doors, windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for the purposes shown in the approved drawings or for other purposes incidental to the enjoyment of 1 Shenley Road as a single family house, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen, bathroom or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
